maplibre-layer-control.description: The on-map layer list. On by default.

maplibre-gl-geo-editor.description: Drawing, vertex editing, snapping, and deletion tools for GeoJSON layers.

maplibre-gl-annotations.description: The map-annotation toolbar (text, arrows, highlights, pins, sticky notes, images) and the Elements panel.

maplibre-gl-dimensions.description: CAD-style linear and angular dimension features with vertex snapping, stored in the project as a GeoJSON layer.

maplibre-gl-fema-wms.description: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer WMS layers.

maplibre-gl-nasa-earthdata.description: Over 1,100 pre-rendered global NASA GIBS imagery layers, by date.

maplibre-gl-enviroatlas.description: US EPA environmental and ecosystem map services.

maplibre-gl-national-map.description: USGS topo, imagery, hydrography, elevation, and index services.

maplibre-usgs-nldi.description: Flowline tracing, hydrolocation, upstream basins, and network navigation.

maplibre-gl-usgs-dem.description: USGS 3DEP digital elevation models (1 m, 1/3 and 1 arc-second, and more).

maplibre-gl-usgs-lidar.description: Clip a USGS 3DEP point cloud to an area of interest and download the result as COPC.

geolibre-planet-open-data.description: Planet's disaster data releases, through the STAC browser.

geolibre-portolan.description: Browse the public Portolan Registry of catalogs, or connect to a publisher's catalog URL, and add assets through the STAC loaders.

maplibre-gl-earthdata-gis.description: NASA EOSDIS ArcGIS image, map, and feature services, and published web maps.

maplibre-gl-openaerialmap.description: Openly licensed drone and aerial imagery.

geolibre-osm-downloader.description: Download OpenStreetMap buildings, roads, amenities, waterways, land use, or custom tags through Overpass.

geolibre-ign-lidar-hd.description: Search France's IGN LiDAR HD tile coverage and download COPC point clouds.

geolibre-arcgis-portal.description: Browse and add the content of your ArcGIS Online organization or ArcGIS Enterprise portal after signing in.

maplibre-gl-arcgis-hub.description: Public datasets published to ArcGIS Hub.

geolibre-tennessee-gis.description: The geodata.tn.gov open GIS data portal.

geolibre-us-federal-gis.description: The public GIS portals of 24 US federal agencies.

geolibre-us-state-gis.description: The public GIS data portals of all 50 states and DC.

geolibre-us-local-gis.description: The GIS and open-data portals of about 150 large US cities, counties, and regional agencies.

geolibre-stac-catalogs.description: Any STAC API or static catalog, via STAC Index.

maplibre-gl-source-coop.description: Cloud-native products (PMTiles, GeoParquet, COG) on Source Cooperative.

geolibre-s3-browser.description: Browse any Amazon S3 or S3-compatible bucket, public or private, and add its files.

maplibre-gl-natural-earth.description: The Natural Earth vector and raster themes.

maplibre-gl-huggingface.description: Geospatial files in Hugging Face dataset repos, and uploads to them.

geolibre-satellite-embeddings.description: Pre-computed foundation-model embeddings such as AlphaEarth, Tessera, and Earth Index.

geolibre-fields-of-the-world.description: Global agricultural field boundaries for 2017–2025, colored by model score.

geolibre-sentinel2-explorer.description: Sentinel-2 imagery search and viewer over static STAC-GeoParquet, with no API.

geolibre-ocean-data-platform.description: HUB Ocean's public ocean datasets: habitats, protected areas, fisheries, and observations.

geolibre-dynamical.description: dynamical.org weather forecasts, ensembles and analyses (NOAA GFS, GEFS, HRRR and MRMS, ECMWF AIFS and IFS, DWD ICON-EU, ECCC HRDPS, NASA IMERG) as Zarr layers.

maplibre-gl-streetview.description: Google Street View panoramas at a clicked point.

maplibre-h3-grid.description: The H3 hexagonal grid over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-s2-grid.description: The S2 cell grid over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-a5-grid.description: The A5 pentagonal grid over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-dggrid.description: DGGRID discrete global grids over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-dggal.description: DGGAL discrete global grids over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-olc.description: The Open Location Code (plus code) grid over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-geohash.description: The Geohash grid over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-tilecode.description: The web-map tile grid (z/x/y tile codes) over the current view; identify a cell and export the grid or selection.

maplibre-gl-basemap-control.description: A basemap gallery for switching the background map, from the same catalog as the Change background dialog.

maplibre-gl-esri-wayback.description: Browse historical aerial and satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery Wayback) for a location.

maplibre-gl-time-slider.description: Filter a temporal layer by a date or number field, or step a time-enabled raster or Zarr cube through its time axis.

geolibre-timelapse.description: Animate annual cloudless basemaps (EOX Sentinel-2, NASA GIBS Landsat/WELD and MODIS land cover) and record them to video.

maplibre-gl-overture-maps.description: Browse and add Overture Maps themes.

geolibre-elevation-profile.description: A terrain profile along a drawn line, or along the selected line features of a layer.

maplibre-gl-swipe.description: A swipe bar comparing two layers.

maplibre-gl-graticule.description: A coordinate grid with edge labels, including UTM easting/northing and MGRS/USNG modes.

maplibre-gl-clouds.description: Near-realtime NASA cloud imagery, animated day by day.

maplibre-gl-precipitation.description: RainViewer precipitation radar, animated over roughly the last two hours.

maplibre-atmosphere-effects.description: A deep-space backdrop, starfield, comets, and an atmospheric halo at low zoom.

geolibre-sun.description: The sun's position and the day/night terminator for any date and time.

geolibre-route-animation.description: Animate a marker along a line layer with play/pause, speed, a trail, and camera follow.

geolibre-flight-simulator.description: Fly over terrain and 3D layers with keyboard controls.

gods-eye-view.description: Live earthquakes, satellite orbits, flights, transit, public cameras, and more on the Cesium globe.

geolibre-point-cloud-annotation.description: Select LiDAR points with a box or lasso, assign ASPRS classes, and export LAS 1.4 or a Segments.ai label.

maplibre-gl-directions.description: Click the map to add waypoints and get a route from the public OSRM demo server.

maplibre-reverse-geocode.description: Click the map to look up the address at that point through the configured geocoding provider.

maplibre-deckgl-viz.description: The deck.gl overlay that renders layers built in the Deck.gl Layer dialog.

maplibre-gl-components.description: The component panels; each is toggled from the Controls menu rather than as one plugin.
